PRINTERS.py.summary: This class models the Android Smart Printers management flow. It encapsulates all user interactions for printer discovery, selection, and management, following the Page Object Model. Key features include: comprehensive CRUD operations for printers, robust exception handling with configurable error raising, explicit waits for asynchronous UI elements, and fallback handling for printer discovery failures. The class leverages Selenium WebDriver for automation and provides methods for state verification, list management, and user-driven actions, ensuring reliable and maintainable test flows.

methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the Printers flow object with driver instance.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Selenium WebDriver instance for mobile automation
